newsitem.title: USA: Hill, W. House agree to economic tax breaks for DC.
newsitem.headline: Hill, W. House agree to economic tax breaks for DC.

text.p: U.S. tax legislation agreed to by congressional leaders and the White House would include a economic relief package for the District of Columbia, a senior congressional aide said Tuesday.
The aide said an existing "enterprise community" in the District would be converted into an "empowerment zone" and expanded.
"Added to that geographic area are all census tracts with greater than 20 percent poverty (rate)," the aide said.
The package also includes a $5,000 tax credit for first-time homebuyers in the District, which would apply through the year 2000, the aide said.
However, the the credit would be phased out for singles earning $40,000 to $50,000 and joint filers earning $80,000 to $100,000, the aide said.
